sections.title: Principles and Techniques of Applied Math II
sections.description: This course is a continuation of ENM 5200 (or equivalent) and deals with classical methods in applied mathematics. The topics to be covered include: Functions of a Complex Variable, Partial Differential Equations, Asymptotic and Perturbation Methods, and Convex Analysis and Variational Methods.
